dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, is smoking allowed in restaurants in Thailand?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪz ˈsmoʊkɪŋ əˈlaʊd ɪn ˈrɛstərɑːnts ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. The law prevents people from smoking in restaurants, malls and offices.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. ðə ˈlɔː prɪˈvɛnts ˈpiːpəl frəm ˈsmoʊkɪŋ ɪn ˈrɛstərɑːnts, ˈmɔːlz ənd ˈɔːfɪsɪz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's good. We have similar restrictions in the US.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡʊd. wiː ˈhæv ˈsɪmələr rɪˈstrɪkʃənz ɪn ðə ˌjuːˈɛs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How old do you have to be to get a driver's license there?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈoʊld duː juː ˈhæf tə bi tə ˈɡɛt ə ˈdraɪvərz ˌlaɪsəns ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: In most places, sixteen. What's the age limit in Thailand?
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈmoʊst ˈpleɪsɪz, ˌsɪkˈstiːn. ˈwʌts ði ˈeɪdʒ ˌlɪmɪt ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: For cars, it's eighteen. But the law allows fifteen-year-olds to ride small motorcycles.
dialogue.reading: fər ˈkɑːrz, ɪts ˌeɪˈtiːn. bʌt ðə ˈlɔː əˈlaʊz ˌfɪfˈtiːn jɪr ˈoʊldz tə ˈraɪd ˈsmɔːl ˈmoʊtərsaɪkəlz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Fifteen? That's young! Are there any restrictions for new drivers?
dialogue.reading: ˌfɪfˈtiːn? ðæts ˈjʌŋ! ər ðɛr ˈɛni rɪˈstrɪkʃənz fər ˈnuː ˈdraɪvərz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. First, you get a license for two years. After that, you can get a five-year one.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈfɜːrst, juː ˈɡɛt ə ˈlaɪsəns fər ˈtuː ˈjɪrz. ˈæftər ˈðæt, juː kən ˈɡɛt ə ˈfaɪv ˈjɪr ˈwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I see. Some countries want to ban children from using social media, too.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. sʌm ˈkʌntriz ˈwɑːnt tə ˈbæn ˈtʃɪldrən frəm ˈjuːzɪŋ ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Right. Australia has banned children under sixteen from having accounts.
dialogue.reading: ˈraɪt. ɔːˈstreɪliə hæz ˈbænd ˈtʃɪldrən ˈʌndər ˌsɪkˈstiːn frəm ˈhævɪŋ əˈkaʊnts.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Do you think that will stop kids from spending all day online?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈθɪŋk ðæt wɪl ˈstɑːp ˈkɪdz frəm ˈspɛndɪŋ ˈɔːl ˈdeɪ ˌɑːnˈlaɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm not sure. A ban can't prevent teenagers from lying about their age.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈʃʊr. ə ˈbæn ˈkænt prɪˈvɛnt ˈtiːneɪdʒərz frəm ˈlaɪɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðɛr ˈeɪdʒ.
